packages.what: Pull, read, and browse the live web from an agent — a grounded research loop.

elements.name: Claude Code
elements.what: Anthropic's agentic coding CLI; extended by a library of 100,000+ installable AI Skills that turn it into a specialist for UI design, app dev, SEO, lead generation, content writing, testing, marketing, and automation.

elements.name: Perplexity MCP
elements.what: Gives Claude Code live internet access through Perplexity search, so answers reflect the current web. Useful for up-to-date research while coding.
elements.install: MCP server (add to Claude Code config)

elements.name: Firecrawl MCP
elements.what: Crawls and scrapes entire websites into clean text for RAG and context. Handles JS-heavy pages and can bypass many captchas.

elements.name: Playwright MCP
elements.what: Lets Claude Code drive a real browser: navigate, click, fill forms, run tests and upload files. Turns the agent into a browser operator.

packages.name: Grounded writing
packages.what: Write with anti-hallucination + context-only guardrails on a strong system prompt.

elements.name: Master Assistant System Prompt
elements.what: A strong, reusable system prompt for a general-purpose assistant: capable, direct, grounded.

elements.name: Anti-Hallucination Guardrail ("do not lie")
elements.what: Stop the model from fabricating. Forces 'I don't know', confidence, and no fake citations.

elements.name: Grounded-to-Context Only (RAG guardrail)
elements.what: Answer ONLY from provided context; refuse or flag when the answer isn't there.

packages.name: Agent building kit
packages.what: Stand up an agent loop with power MCPs in Claude Code.
